verdict: Dr. Ayaz proves that while e to the power of negative infinity approaches zero, his fashion sense hit absolute zero long before taking this tenure.
detailedQuote: Pairing a stiff corporate navy blazer with embroidered light-wash dad jeans is a bold cry for help from someone who refuses to round a 79.9% up to a B-. He clearly spends his three-hour lecture writing limits on the board while completely ignoring the five hands raised in total confusion.

inventory.name: Dark Navy Blazer of Depressing Tenure Security
inventory.description: An ill-fitting dark navy blazer worn solely to maintain the illusion of academic prestige while failing 70% of the sophomore class.

inventory.name: Faded Light Blue Pocket-Embroidered Dad Jeans
inventory.description: Mid-2000s light-wash denim featuring aggressive back-pocket stitching that surrenders completely to any expectation of modern style.

inventory.name: Wire-Rimmed Partial-Credit Deductor Glasses
inventory.description: Rectangular spectacles designed purely to squint at your step-by-step calculus work and find a missing negative sign from 15 paces away.
